positions.clause: Exactly one batch of at most five sequential calls in the fixed order genesis, tip, address_utxos, epoch_params with explicit chosen epoch, tip; no paging, repeated address observation, or batch retry.
positions.rationale: Matches documented four-path contract in SOURCE-CONTRACTS.md:24-31 and bounds provider load.

positions.clause: Use literal retries=1 at Scrapling session and request level for exactly one controller-level attempt; never retries=0.
positions.rationale: static.py:231-232,248 uses max(1, retries or 1) with range(max_retries); literal 1 is also one attempt under a range(retries) reading.

positions.clause: Pin follow_redirects=False, max_redirects=0, verify=True, stealthy_headers=False, impersonate=None; reject any redirect history or canonical-URL difference.
positions.rationale: static.py:73-84,673-675 defaults are chrome impersonation, stealth Google referer, and safe redirects unless overridden.

positions.clause: Accept only HTTP 200 application/json, append raw bytes before validation, never accept a partial failed response, and preserve partial RESULT/ledger best-effort (initial STARTED save, save after ledger append before each request, BLOCKED_PARTIAL_PRESERVED on Abort or any other Exception); a physical write failure can prevent the final receipt, in which case the root outer captured terminal output is the authority rather than a universal preservation guarantee.
positions.rationale: Repairs F4: R1 saved only after response and caught only Abort; R2 saves before launch, distinguishes transport_attempted from response_received, and honestly bounds the preservation claim.

positions.clause: Check the 2 MiB bound before persist/JSON while honestly stating Scrapling buffers the whole body first; treat any address-space limit as a bound, not a strict download cap, and claim no stream cap.
positions.rationale: custom.py:83-86 exposes body as already-materialized bytes; no streaming interface is in the inspected source.

positions.clause: Freeze provider genesis checks to documented string fields equal to static Preprod values (networkmagic 1, networkid Testnet, epochlength 432000, slotlength 1, systemstart 1654041600), coercing only documented strings.
positions.rationale: selected-contracts.json:1005-1052 types these as strings; preprod-shelley-genesis.json:37-38,63-71 supplies the static values; Preview magic 2 prevents Testnet-only conflation.

positions.clause: Bound tx_index as a non-bool integer 0..32767 from the SQL smallint source, require unique outrefs and is_spent exactly false, and keep value as a raw non-negative decimal string with no ADA/lovelace conversion, total balance, or sum.
positions.rationale: address_utxos.sql:4,31-32,44; SOURCE-CONTRACTS.md:37-39 states the conversion is not established.

positions.clause: Treat a proven-complete empty UTxO array as a provider-only unfunded report (not ledger truth), an empty array without proven completeness as provider_reports_empty_bounded_result_completeness_unknown and never valid-unfunded, exactly-1000 rows as bounded-set-only with possible truncation, cost_models as opaque/unsupported, and changed tips as AMBIGUOUS rather than an authenticated snapshot.
positions.rationale: Repairs the F3 half of R1 P08: completeness now depends on the Content-Range evaluation in P12, not on row count alone.

positions.clause: Keep this deliverable source-only: root materializes the R2 sibling fresh (R1 and failed reviews preserved), a fresh full non-author audit follows (not patch-only), and only a separately reviewed single public run may produce a qualifying provider observation; two agreeing positions adopt SOURCE only and create no execution or native authority.
positions.rationale: Indexed fallback confirmation creates no native execution authority; no live Koios query or new authority is recorded.

positions.clause: Pass discard_cookies=True on every get/post call so cookies are not stored in the persistent jar or reused between calls, without claiming that no Set-Cookie was received (the ephemeral response object may still carry one) and without passing any unsupported session-constructor argument.
positions.rationale: F1 repair: static.py:132-157 forwards non-skip non-None per-request kwargs; curl_cffi Session.request accepts discard_cookies (session.py:890,939); FetcherSession constructor (static.py:661-679) exposes no such argument.

positions.clause: Make no code claim of no proxy/CA environment effect: the source passes no explicit proxy/auth and cannot disable trust_env at the FetcherSession constructor, so root must launch with exactly the clean environment dict PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, HOME=/nonexistent, LC_ALL=C, TZ=UTC, PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1, PYTHONPATH=/home/charl/.local/lib/python3.14/site-packages (not an inherited environment, no proxy/CA/credential entries at all), pin the actual observed interpreter path itself, and never use -I or assume user-site loading under HOME=/nonexistent.
positions.rationale: F2 repair: trust_env=True (session.py:238) and CA env fallback (session.py:311-316) cannot be disabled through Scrapling; indexed utils.py sets PROXY only when proxies are supplied (utils.py:840-859) and CAINFO from the session verify value (utils.py:894-896), so the exact clean dict is an operator precondition, not a trust theorem.

positions.clause: Pass the allowlisted Content-Range into UTxO validation and prove completeness only when the range exactly covers all returned rows (start 0, end total-1, count = total) or is */0 with zero rows; flag partial, unknown-total (0-2/*, */*), absent, malformed, and row-count-mismatched ranges as bounded/incomplete or completeness-unknown, keep the exactly-1000 possible-truncation flag, and add no paging, retry, extra request, or Prefer header.
positions.rationale: F3 repair: R1 retained the header (observe.py:234-235) but never evaluated it; PostgREST range forms are now each classified explicitly.

positions.clause: Save the initial STARTED RESULT immediately and after each ledger append before the request, record transport_attempted versus response_received distinctly, finalize Abort with its source-known message and any other Exception (including session-enter failure) as BLOCKED_PARTIAL_PRESERVED with the exception type name only, and never overwrite existing output (root passes the exact fresh O).
positions.rationale: F4 repair: closes the no-RESULT session-enter gap and the stale-STARTED non-Abort gap while keeping the honest best-effort bound stated in P04.

positions.clause: Reject duplicate JSON keys, literal NaN/Infinity, and numeric overflow (for example 1e999) through a finite parse_float check, serialize RESULT with allow_nan=False, retain raw actual bytes, keep cost_models opaque, and perform no fee calculation.
positions.rationale: F5 repair: R1 rejected literal constants but allowed overflow to inf in opaque fields to be re-emitted as non-strict JSON.

positions.clause: Treat FSIZE 8 MiB as per-file (not aggregate), retain full raw bodies as exact separate step files, and bound RESULT to whitelisted known-field summaries plus raw-file references (cost_models as type/shape unknown plus raw reference, no invented decoder) with a bounded compact fallback if the summary ever exceeded the receipt guard, so no raw observation is silently discarded.
positions.rationale: F6 repair: R1 duplicated entire parsed state into an indented RESULT, letting unbounded opaque extra fields exceed 8 MiB despite the per-body 2 MiB check.
